# Reine Fondange AI

> Reine Fondange AI is an AI-guided trading platform for verified Australian residents. Crypto, forex and equities with curated signals, risk guardrails and bank-grade security.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://reinefondange-ai.com/): platform overview, live market ticker, registration form
- [How It Works](https://reinefondange-ai.com/how-it-works): the six-step path from signup to first trade
- [Why Invest](https://reinefondange-ai.com/why-invest): custody, security and platform safeguards
- [FAQ](https://reinefondange-ai.com/faq): deposits, withdrawals, KYC, fees and more
- [About Us](https://reinefondange-ai.com/about-us): company principles and stats
